content: So꞉l e asulo꞉wo꞉ nodolo꞉

O꞉g ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ So꞉l eyo꞉ Alan amilo꞉ tilidabu kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ yasala꞉ma꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉liki towo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li sia꞉len. E mo꞉fo꞉so꞉ dia꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉liki, bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen misa꞉ kalu elo꞉wa dabu ba꞉ba꞉ni ane.

So꞉l e Damaskas amisa꞉na ha꞉na꞉no꞉ asulabiki, e a꞉na ha꞉na꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Alana꞉ Mando꞉ kudu ha꞉nab kaluka꞉isale a꞉no꞉ ba꞉dalega, iyo꞉ ta꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, a꞉ma꞉la꞉ tililia꞉ga꞉, Ya꞉lusalem dibolo aya to꞉loma꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉asulo꞉. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ So꞉l eyo꞉ bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen kalu eyo꞉ o꞉lika꞉ a꞉la꞉liki mo꞉fo꞉s nowo꞉ sa꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, emo꞉ dimiab amio꞉, eyo꞉ dia꞉ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ Damaskasdo꞉ tolo꞉ widan misa꞉ kalu dosdo꞉mo꞉ walama꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉liki, dabu ba꞉ba꞉ni ane.

Mo꞉fo꞉s a꞉no꞉ dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Damaskas amisa꞉no꞉ ko꞉na꞉ma fa꞉la꞉doma꞉no꞉ dowab amio꞉, wigibole a꞉naka ho꞉ nowo꞉ wabeleg o꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ Hebene halona a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ so꞉so꞉lelia꞉ga꞉ tindaki, So꞉l e a꞉ma꞉ hegelia꞉ga꞉ difa꞉.
A꞉la꞉gabiki So꞉l e hena sulufo꞉ tina꞉sa꞉ga꞉ deliki, to nowo꞉ emo꞉ sa꞉labiki dabu. “So꞉l, So꞉l, Giyo꞉ ne mogagakiyo꞉, waga migi kudaya?”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, So꞉l eyo꞉, “Alan, ge o꞉ba?” a꞉la꞉sio꞉. “Ne Ya꞉su ko꞉lo꞉ gilo꞉ mogagila꞉leyo꞉ ne.
Ge dasilia꞉ga꞉, amisa꞉n usa ti hamana. A꞉namio꞉, kalu imilig noma꞉yo꞉ gilo꞉ dimidama꞉no꞉wo꞉ wala sa꞉ma꞉ib” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Kalu So꞉l o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ ane iliyo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ dabu ko꞉sega, kalu misio꞉ mo꞉ba꞉dabiki, iyo꞉ modaki tolo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉ma꞉no꞉ dowo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ So꞉l e dasila꞉sa꞉ga꞉ siya꞉yo꞉ sigido꞉ ko꞉sega, kelego꞉wo꞉ mada mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉no꞉ dowabiki, iliyo꞉ e dagiya gasilia꞉ga꞉, Damaskas amisa꞉n a꞉na tililia꞉gane.
E ho꞉len otaleno꞉ siyo꞉ mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉no꞉ dowabiki, e ma꞉n o꞉lia꞉ ho꞉n o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉mo꞉no꞉.
Damaskas amisa꞉n a꞉namio꞉ tilidabu kalu nowo꞉, Ananaias e a꞉na sen. E ho꞉le ba꞉dakiyo꞉, Alana꞉yo꞉ “Ananaias!” a꞉la꞉ho꞉idabiki dabu. Eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Alan, ne weko꞉.”

Alana꞉yo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge Tog Digalo꞉ a꞉na ha꞉na꞉ga꞉, Yudasa꞉ aya fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, Tasus amisa꞉n kalu nowo꞉ ene wiyo꞉ So꞉l ko꞉lo꞉, e ba꞉ba꞉nikiyo꞉, emo꞉wo꞉ dabu ba꞉ba꞉ni hamana. Mo꞉wo꞉ e a a꞉na dulugu sa꞉la꞉liki sab ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉lo꞉ ofolakiyo꞉, kalu imilig nowo꞉ ene wiyo꞉ Ananaias, e elo꞉wa ya꞉ga꞉, e dagiyo꞉ wa꞉la golalikiyo꞉, ene siyo꞉ o꞉li o꞉bo꞉ba꞉ki a꞉la꞉likiyo꞉ ofowo꞉ ba꞉ba꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, ge elo꞉wa hamana.”
Ananaias eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Alan, ne kalu koma꞉lo꞉ gi tilidabu kaluka꞉isale Ya꞉lusalemdo꞉ sab o꞉mo꞉lo꞉ mogago꞉ dimida꞉seno꞉ modo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dabu.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ e bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen misa꞉ kaluwa꞉ to halaido꞉ saefa꞉ a꞉no꞉ dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, o꞉go꞉ amisa꞉n wena ya꞉ga꞉, tilidabu kaluka꞉isale a꞉no꞉ ta꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, dibolo aya to꞉loma꞉ni mio꞉.”

Ko꞉sega Alana꞉yo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ha꞉la꞉ kaluwo꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ene misa꞉ kaluwo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Isolael kalu o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ tambo no꞉no꞉n wiyo꞉ walama꞉ki, kalu we no꞉no꞉n da꞉fe alifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ ge elo꞉wa hamana.
E ni wiyo꞉ widalikilo꞉, hida꞉yo꞉ ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉ ba꞉da꞉i ha꞉na꞉no꞉wo꞉, no꞉no꞉no꞉ walama꞉no꞉” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Ananaias e ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, a elo꞉ sab a꞉na tina꞉ga꞉, e dagiya꞉yo꞉ Solo꞉ golakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Nao So꞉l, ne Alana꞉yo꞉ gelo꞉wa iliga꞉tabi mio꞉. Ge toga ya꞉len amilo꞉, Ya꞉su gelo꞉ amilo꞉ handalowo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ iliga꞉tabi mio꞉. Ge wa꞉ka o꞉li ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godeya꞉ Mamayo꞉ ge amio꞉ wa꞉lifoma꞉ki, ne gelo꞉wa iliga꞉fo꞉.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, wigibo a꞉naka si amilo꞉ kelego꞉ noma꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ o꞉ngo꞉ a꞉no꞉ sululabiki, e o꞉li a꞉ba꞉ba꞉. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ e dasilia꞉ga꞉ ho꞉na to꞉lolo꞉.
E ma꞉no꞉ na꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, halaido꞉wo꞉ o꞉li a꞉dowo꞉. So꞉l e Godeya꞉ mano꞉ wido꞉ Ho꞉len nolo꞉ So꞉l e tilidabu kalu nol o꞉lia꞉ Damaskas amisa꞉n a꞉na sen.
E Yu kaluwa꞉lo꞉ tolo꞉ wida꞉sen aya bo꞉bo꞉ge walama꞉ni ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, “Ya꞉su E Godeya꞉ ene So꞉wale” a꞉la꞉liki wido꞉.

Kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉ to man elo꞉ widab a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉ga꞉, iligakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ya꞉lusalem usamilo꞉ kaluka꞉isale Ya꞉su amilo꞉ tilidabu ilo꞉ mogagila꞉leno꞉ kalu weyele? A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ e amisa꞉n wenamilo꞉ mio꞉ we, iyo꞉ ta꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen misa꞉ kalulo꞉wa tililia꞉ ha꞉na꞉ni a꞉ngaba꞉le?” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

Ko꞉sega So꞉l elo꞉ to widab a꞉no꞉ mada halaido꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowaki, Ya꞉su E Godeya꞉lo꞉ Da꞉feyo꞉ Kaluwo꞉ Eka꞉ a꞉la꞉liki hendele fanda sa꞉labiki, Yu kalu Damaskasdo꞉ sen a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, a꞉ma꞉la꞉do꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ aundo꞉ma dowo꞉.
A꞉ma꞉ fa꞉s amio꞉, ho꞉len modo꞉wo꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Yu kaluwo꞉ kegea꞉sa꞉ga꞉, So꞉l e sana soma꞉no꞉ nenela꞉sa꞉ga꞉ saefa꞉.
Ko꞉sega So꞉l eyo꞉ ililo꞉ saefa꞉ a꞉no꞉ dabu. Ho꞉len o꞉lia꞉ nulu o꞉lia꞉ amio꞉, iliyo꞉ amisa꞉n amilo꞉ tog ha꞉na꞉sen a꞉namio꞉ e ta꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ sana soma꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉liki yasila꞉len.
Ko꞉sega nulu no amio꞉, So꞉la꞉ enedo꞉ kudu sian kalu iliyo꞉ e asuwa꞉takiyo꞉, asa disa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, amisa꞉na꞉lo꞉ ilif tolo꞉ amilo꞉ ho꞉ gulu nowa meya꞉ sunda꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ha꞉sa to꞉lolo꞉.

E amisa꞉n a꞉namilo꞉ seno꞉ sili alita꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Ya꞉lusalem a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, tilidabu kalu a꞉namilo꞉ sen a꞉no꞉lia꞉ gasama꞉no꞉ asulo꞉ ko꞉sega, e Ya꞉su amio꞉ hendele tilidabu a꞉la꞉bo꞉, iyo꞉ mo꞉fanda asulo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, iliyo꞉ e tagilaki e o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉gasayo꞉.

Ko꞉sega Banabas eyo꞉ So꞉lo꞉ asuwa꞉takiyo꞉, e iliga꞉felo꞉ kalulo꞉wa tililia꞉gane. Banabas eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ dinafa fanda sa꞉lakiyo꞉, So꞉l e Damaskas tog a꞉na ha꞉na꞉lena, elo꞉ Kalu Alan ba꞉ba꞉ a꞉no꞉lia꞉, Alana꞉lo꞉ emo꞉lo꞉ to sio꞉ a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ malolo꞉ me. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ So꞉l e Damaskas amisa꞉na ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Ya꞉suwa꞉ wi sa꞉ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ eyo꞉ mo꞉tagilaki, amisa꞉n amio꞉ wida꞉len a꞉la꞉liki, Banabas eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉na fanda wido꞉.
A꞉la꞉kudu meabiki, So꞉l eyo꞉ i o꞉lia꞉ gasaliaki, Ya꞉lusalem us a꞉namio꞉ nanogo꞉ egele dimidaki, So꞉l e Ya꞉suwa꞉ wiyo꞉ halaido꞉ wido꞉.
So꞉l e Yu kalu, Gilig tolo꞉ sa꞉lan i o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ towa꞉yo꞉ kego꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, iliyo꞉ e sana soma꞉no꞉ dowo꞉.
Ao i, tilidabu nolba꞉yo꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉ga꞉, iliyo꞉ e Sesalia amisa꞉na tililia꞉ ha꞉na꞉ga꞉, Tasus amisa꞉n a꞉na hamana꞉ki ho꞉n ko꞉suwa iliga꞉fo꞉.

A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ tilidabu kaluka꞉isale, Yudia hen o꞉lia꞉ Ga꞉lili heno꞉lo꞉, Samalia heno꞉lo꞉ us a꞉namio꞉ ha꞉sa dowaki sagala꞉li sen. Iliyo꞉ Godeya꞉ mano꞉ dinafa kudu ha꞉nabikiyo꞉, Godeya꞉ Mamaya꞉yo꞉ ili asulo꞉wo꞉ halale alitaki, kalu modo꞉wo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉kudu mio꞉.
Bida eyo꞉ Ainiaso꞉ falele alifa꞉
Bidayo꞉ amisa꞉n ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉wa sia꞉la꞉ga꞉, tilidabu kaluka꞉isale Lida amisa꞉n amilo꞉ seno꞉ e ba꞉ba꞉ni ane.
E a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ amio꞉, kalu nowo꞉ Ainias ko꞉lo꞉ e a꞉na galili. Ainias e ko꞉go꞉neli ko꞉lo꞉, e donayo꞉ ola꞉fo꞉ a꞉no꞉ uwo꞉ba delen.
Bida e fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, Ainias emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ainias, Ya꞉su Kelisowa꞉yo꞉ ge falele alitab ko꞉lo꞉ ge dasila꞉sa꞉ga꞉, geo꞉ndo꞉wo꞉ kamboloma.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, wigibo a꞉naka Ainias e dasi.
Lida amisa꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Salon fua꞉lo꞉ hen a꞉namilo꞉ sen kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉, Ainias e ko꞉lo꞉ falele alitab a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉ga꞉, iyo꞉ asulo꞉wo꞉ nodola꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Alano꞉ kudu ane.
Bida eyo꞉ Tabita e sowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dasi alifa꞉

Yoba amisa꞉n amio꞉ tilidabu ga nowo꞉ a꞉na sen. Ene wiyo꞉ Tabita, ko꞉sega Gilig towa꞉ sa꞉lakiyo꞉, Dokas a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sen. E man nafa dimida꞉likiyo꞉, wa꞉feyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale kelego꞉lo꞉ma a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asuwa꞉ta꞉sen.
Ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ e walaf ba꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉ sowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, ene do꞉mo꞉wo꞉ ho꞉no꞉ mulu alita꞉sa꞉ga꞉, galala꞉ wa꞉l amilo꞉wa dia꞉fo꞉len.

Lida amisa꞉n o꞉lia꞉ Yoba amisa꞉n o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ko꞉na꞉ma ko꞉lo꞉, tilidabu kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ Bida e Lida a꞉na saka꞉ a꞉la꞉da꞉da꞉ga꞉yo꞉, iliyo꞉ kalu a꞉la꞉yo꞉ elo꞉wa iliga꞉ta꞉ga꞉, emo꞉wo꞉ ha꞉nolo sa꞉lakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “O꞉go꞉ ge mada nilo꞉wa mena!”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Bida e a꞉la꞉ o꞉lia꞉ ha꞉na꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowabikiyo꞉, iliyo꞉ e tililia꞉ga꞉, galala꞉ wa꞉l amilo꞉wa tiane. Ga sa꞉ba꞉lo꞉ nolo꞉ elo꞉wa hege kagafo꞉liki ya꞉foda꞉likiyo꞉, Tabita e o꞉silikilo꞉ helebeso꞉g elo꞉ dubio꞉ a꞉no꞉ Bida emo꞉ wido꞉.

Bida eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ tambo ha꞉la꞉ya iliga꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, e gulalu siliki Godemo꞉ dulugu sio꞉. E ga sowo꞉lo꞉ doba꞉da꞉ nodolakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Tabita, ge dasima!” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, ga a꞉no꞉ siyo꞉ fagela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Bida e sikudu ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e dasi asi.

Bida eyo꞉ ga a꞉no꞉ dagiya gasilia꞉ga꞉, dasi alifa꞉. A꞉la꞉dimida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, eyo꞉ tilidabu kaluka꞉isale o꞉lia꞉ ga sa꞉ba꞉lo꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ho꞉ida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ga sowo꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ dasi sab a꞉la꞉liki imo꞉wo꞉ wido꞉.
Elo꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉, Yoba amisa꞉n amio꞉ sa꞉la꞉i ha꞉nabikiyo꞉, tambo dabu ko꞉lo꞉, iyo꞉ Alan amio꞉ modo꞉ tilidabu.
Bida e ho꞉len nolo꞉ Yoba amisa꞉n a꞉namio꞉, no꞉ do꞉go꞉fdo꞉ dinafaya꞉sen kalu, Saimon e aya sen.
